items.headline: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin posts up to 2x GB300's per-GPU training speed on MLPerf
items.excerpt: NVIDIA reported on 16 November that its Vera Rubin NVL72 system delivered up to 2x the per-GPU training performance of GB300 NVL72 in MLPerf Training v6.1.

items.headline: Bland released Tofu-1, a full-duplex voice model for phone calls
items.excerpt: Bland released Tofu-1 on 15 November, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for phone calls, and says over 92% of listeners in its screenings could not tell it was a model.

items.headline: DeepSeek opened its app's search, file reading and voice tools to API developers
items.excerpt: DeepSeek opened its chatbot's web search, file input and URL reading inside its APIs on 13 November, with search billed at $0.75 per 1,000 calls.

items.headline: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet so agents can buy for US Pro subscribers
items.excerpt: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet on 13 November, which lets ChatGPT agents check out and pay for orders for US ChatGPT Pro subscribers once the user approves each purchase biometrically.

items.headline: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen and made it the model behind Search
items.excerpt: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen on 12 November at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, and made it the model behind Search for all users.

items.headline: Google's Gemini Decision 1 scores up to 1,000 questions per request in one pass
items.excerpt: Google released Gemini Decision 1 on 11 November, a model that answers up to 1,000 closed-set questions in one request for $0.10 per million input tokens and bills no output tokens.

items.headline: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code verified Signal's protocol code in Lean in four weeks
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind says its AlphaProof Code framework formally verified the implementation of Signal's cryptographic protocol in Lean in four weeks, writing over six million lines of proof.
